## Overview

This document establishes the data foundation for Bridging London, a spatial analysis of how the River Thames influences cycling connectivity across London’s Santander Cycles network. Using R, docking station locations are retrieved from the Transport for London (TfL) API, historical journey records are imported, and river geometry is sourced from the Greater London Authority (GLA). The workflow inspects spatial data structures, coordinate reference systems and geometry validity before testing bicycle routing using the Open Source Routing Machine (OSRM). Together, these steps establish a reproducible foundation for subsequent origin–destination analysis, network distance calculations and comparisons of cycling connectivity across the Thames.


```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(osrm)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)
library(stplanr)
```

```{r download-docking-stations}
station_url <- "https://api.tfl.gov.uk/BikePoint"
station_file <- "data/raw/bikepoints.json"

# Download once and retain the original API response
if (!file.exists(station_file)) {
  response <- GET(station_url)
  stop_for_status(response)

  writeBin(content(response, as = "raw"), station_file)
}

# Import JSON into R
stations_raw <- fromJSON(station_file)

# Inspect the dataset
dim(stations_raw)
names(stations_raw)

head(stations_raw[c("id", "commonName", "lat", "lon")])
```
```{r inspect-journeys}
journey_files <- list.files(
  "data/raw/journeys",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Confirm that journey files are available
print(journey_files)
stopifnot(length(journey_files) > 0)

# Inspect the structure of the first file
journey_sample <- read_csv(
  journey_files[1],
  n_max = 10,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

names(journey_sample)
glimpse(journey_sample)
```
```{r download-thames}
thames_file <- "data/raw/thames.geojson"

# Greater London Authority River Thames dataset
thames_url <- paste0(
  "https://gis.london.gov.uk/arcgis/rest/services/",
  "apps/webmap_context_layer/MapServer/1/query",
  "?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&returnGeometry=true",
  "&outSR=4326&f=geojson"
)

# Download and store locally
if (!file.exists(thames_file)) {
  download.file(thames_url, thames_file, mode = "wb")
}

# Import as an sf object
thames_raw <- st_read(thames_file)
```
```{r inspect-thames}
# Inspect geometry and spatial coverage
st_geometry_type(thames_raw)
st_crs(thames_raw)
st_bbox(thames_raw)

# Check geometry validity
table(st_is_valid(thames_raw))

# Visual inspection
plot(
  st_geometry(thames_raw),
  col = "#82B5D1",
  border = NA
)
```

```{r test-cycling-route}
# Configure OSRM for bicycle routing
options(
  osrm.server = "https://routing.openstreetmap.de/",
  osrm.profile = "bike"
)

# Test locations on opposite sides of the Thames
origin <- c(-0.1275, 51.5074)
destination <- c(-0.1130, 51.5033)

# Calculate a cycling route
test_route <- osrmRoute(
  src = origin,
  dst = destination,
  overview = "full"
)

print(test_route)
```

```{r visualise-test-route}
route_bbox <- st_bbox(st_transform(test_route, 4326))

leaflet() |>
  
  # Muted contextual basemap
  addTiles(
    options = tileOptions(opacity = 0.35)
  ) |>
  
  # River Thames
  addPolygons(
    data = st_transform(thames_raw, 4326),
    fillColor = "#82B5D1",
    fillOpacity = 0.25,
    stroke = FALSE
  ) |>
  
  # White outline underneath the route
  addPolylines(
    data = st_transform(test_route, 4326),
    color = "#FFFFFF",
    weight = 8,
    opacity = 1
  ) |>
  
  # Cycling route
  addPolylines(
    data = st_transform(test_route, 4326),
    color = "#D97706",
    weight = 5,
    opacity = 1
  ) |>
  
  # Origin and destination
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = c(origin[1], destination[1]),
    lat = c(origin[2], destination[2]),
    radius = 7,
    color = "#FFFFFF",
    weight = 2,
    fillColor = "#173F5F",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    label = c("Origin", "Destination")
  ) |>
  
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = as.numeric(route_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.003,
    lat1 = as.numeric(route_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.003,
    lng2 = as.numeric(route_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.003,
    lat2 = as.numeric(route_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.003
  )
```

## Data Cleaning and Preparation

The following steps standardise docking station records, inspect and combine the historical journey extracts, and prepare the datasets for origin–destination analysis.

```{r clean-stations}
stations <- stations_raw |>
  transmute(
    bikepoint_id = id,
    station_name = commonName,
    longitude = lon,
    latitude = lat
  )

# Inspect the cleaned dataset
glimpse(stations)

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(stations))

# Check for duplicate station identifiers
sum(duplicated(stations$bikepoint_id))
```

```{r inspect-station-identifiers}
head(stations)

# Inspect additional station metadata
stations_raw$additionalProperties[[1]]
```

```{r create-spatial-stations}
# Ensure valid coordinates and unique identifiers
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(stations),
  !anyDuplicated(stations$bikepoint_id),
  all(abs(stations$longitude) <= 180),
  all(abs(stations$latitude) <= 90)
)

# Convert coordinates into point geometries
stations_sf <- st_as_sf(
  stations,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

# Transform to British National Grid
stations_bng <- st_transform(stations_sf, 27700)

# Inspect the spatial dataset
print(stations_bng)
```

```{r inspect-station-distribution}
leaflet(stations_sf) |>
  addTiles(
    options = tileOptions(opacity = 0.35)
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    radius = 3,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillColor = "#173F5F",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    label = ~station_name
  )
```

```{r check-journey-headers}
journey_headers <- lapply(
  journey_files,
  function(file) {
    names(read_csv(
      file,
      n_max = 0,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ))
  }
)

# Inspect the column names of each file
journey_headers

# Check consistency between files
stopifnot(
  all(vapply(
    journey_headers,
    identical,
    logical(1),
    journey_headers[[1]]
  ))
)
```

```{r import-journeys}
# Retain filenames for data provenance
names(journey_files) <- basename(journey_files)

journeys_raw <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    journey_files,
    function(file) {
      read_csv(
        file,
        col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
      )
    }
  ),
  .id = "source_file"
)

# Inspect combined dataset
dim(journeys_raw)
glimpse(journeys_raw)

# Number of records from each file
count(journeys_raw, source_file)
```

```{r extract-terminal-identifiers}
# Extract TerminalName from each station's metadata
terminal_ids <- vapply(
  stations_raw$additionalProperties,
  function(x) {
    value <- x$value[which(x$key == "TerminalName")]

    if (length(value) == 1) {
      return(as.character(value))
    }

    return(NA_character_)
  },
  FUN.VALUE = character(1)
)

# Add the historical station identifier
stopifnot(identical(stations$bikepoint_id, stations_raw$id))

stations <- stations |>
  mutate(station_id = trimws(terminal_ids))

# Inspect the result
head(stations)

# Check identifier quality
sum(is.na(stations$station_id))
sum(duplicated(stations$station_id))
```

```{r update-spatial-stations}
# Retain stations with usable terminal identifiers
stations <- stations |>
  filter(!is.na(station_id), station_id != "")

# Ensure terminal identifiers are unique
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(stations$station_id))

# Rebuild spatial objects with the new identifier
stations_sf <- st_as_sf(
  stations,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

stations_bng <- st_transform(stations_sf, 27700)
```

```{r clean-journeys}
# Remove exact duplicate records across source files
duplicate_rows <- duplicated(
  journeys_raw[setdiff(names(journeys_raw), "source_file")]
)

journeys <- journeys_raw[!duplicate_rows, ] |>
  transmute(
    journey_id = Number,
    start_date = as.Date(substr(`Start date`, 1, 10)),
    origin_id = trimws(`Start station number`),
    destination_id = trimws(`End station number`),
    origin_name = `Start station`,
    destination_name = `End station`,
    duration_min = as.numeric(`Total duration (ms)`) / 60000,
    source_file = source_file
  )

# Inspect cleaned records
glimpse(journeys)

# Data quality checks
sum(duplicate_rows)
colSums(is.na(journeys))
sum(duplicated(journeys$journey_id))
range(journeys$start_date, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r validate-station-matching}
journeys <- journeys |>
  mutate(
    origin_matched = origin_id %in% stations$station_id,
    destination_matched = destination_id %in% stations$station_id
  )

# Calculate matching success
matching_summary <- journeys |>
  summarise(
    total_journeys = n(),
    matched_origins = sum(origin_matched),
    matched_destinations = sum(destination_matched),
    fully_matched = sum(origin_matched & destination_matched),
    match_rate = mean(
      origin_matched & destination_matched
    ) * 100
  )

matching_summary
```

```{r inspect-unmatched-stations}
# Unmatched origins
journeys |>
  filter(!origin_matched) |>
  count(origin_id, origin_name, sort = TRUE) |>
  head(10)

# Unmatched destinations
journeys |>
  filter(!destination_matched) |>
  count(destination_id, destination_name, sort = TRUE) |>
  head(10)
```

```{r filter-journeys}
# Confirm unique journey identifiers
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(journeys$journey_id),
  !anyDuplicated(journeys$journey_id)
)

journeys_clean <- journeys |>
  filter(
    start_date >= as.Date("2026-03-01"),
    start_date <= as.Date("2026-03-31"),
    origin_matched,
    destination_matched,
    origin_id != destination_id
  ) |>
  mutate(
    duration_min = if_else(
      duration_min > 0 & is.finite(duration_min),
      duration_min,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

# Compare before and after cleaning
data.frame(
  original_records = nrow(journeys_raw),
  retained_records = nrow(journeys_clean),
  excluded_records = nrow(journeys_raw) - nrow(journeys_clean)
)
```

```{r resolve-station-discrepancies}
# Combine historical origin and destination station names
historical_stations <- bind_rows(
  journeys_clean |>
    select(
      station_id = origin_id,
      historical_name = origin_name
    ),
  journeys_clean |>
    select(
      station_id = destination_id,
      historical_name = destination_name
    )
) |>
  distinct()

# Identify inconsistent station names
station_discrepancies <- historical_stations |>
  inner_join(
    stations |>
      select(station_id, station_name),
    by = "station_id"
  ) |>
  filter(
    tolower(trimws(historical_name)) !=
      tolower(trimws(station_name))
  )

print(station_discrepancies)

# Identify ambiguous station IDs
excluded_ids <- unique(station_discrepancies$station_id)

# Record journey count before exclusion
n_before <- nrow(journeys_clean)

# Exclude affected journeys
journeys_clean <- journeys_clean |>
  filter(
    !origin_id %in% excluded_ids,
    !destination_id %in% excluded_ids
  )

# Report impact of additional cleaning
data.frame(
  ambiguous_stations = length(excluded_ids),
  additional_exclusions = n_before - nrow(journeys_clean),
  retained_journeys = nrow(journeys_clean)
)
```

## Methodological decision

Historical journey records were cross-referenced against current docking station names to identify inconsistencies arising from the temporal mismatch between datasets. Journeys associated with ambiguous station identifiers were excluded to minimise the risk of assigning incorrect geographical coordinates during subsequent network analysis.


```{r aggregate-od-pairs}
od_pairs <- journeys_clean |>
  group_by(origin_id, destination_id) |>
  summarise(
    journeys = n(),
    mean_duration_min = mean(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    mean_duration_min = if_else(
      is.nan(mean_duration_min),
      NA_real_,
      mean_duration_min
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(journeys))

# Inspect the busiest station pairs
head(od_pairs, 10)

# Number of unique directional relationships
nrow(od_pairs)

# Confirm all retained journeys are accounted for
stopifnot(
  sum(od_pairs$journeys) == nrow(journeys_clean)
)
```

```{r join-station-coordinates}
od_pairs <- od_pairs |>
  left_join(
    stations |>
      select(
        origin_id = station_id,
        origin_name = station_name,
        origin_lon = longitude,
        origin_lat = latitude
      ),
    by = "origin_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    stations |>
      select(
        destination_id = station_id,
        destination_name = station_name,
        destination_lon = longitude,
        destination_lat = latitude
      ),
    by = "destination_id"
  )

# Validate the completed dataset
glimpse(od_pairs)
colSums(is.na(od_pairs))

stopifnot(
  sum(od_pairs$journeys) == nrow(journeys_clean)
)
```

```{r export-processed-data}
# Spatial station datasets
saveRDS(
  stations_sf,
  "data/processed/stations_wgs84.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  stations_bng,
  "data/processed/stations_bng.rds"
)

# Aggregated origin-destination dataset
saveRDS(
  od_pairs,
  "data/processed/od_pairs.rds"
)

# River Thames in British National Grid
saveRDS(
  st_transform(thames_raw, 27700),
  "data/processed/thames_bng.rds"
)

# Confirm exported files
list.files("data/processed")
```

```{r final-data-summary}
# Summarise the final analytical datasets
data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "Raw journey records",
    "Duplicate records",
    "Retained journeys",
    "Docking stations",
    "Unique OD pairs",
    "Station matching rate (%)",
    "Journey retention rate (%)"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(journeys_raw),
    sum(duplicate_rows),
    nrow(journeys_clean),
    nrow(stations),
    nrow(od_pairs),
    round(matching_summary$match_rate, 2),
    round(nrow(journeys_clean) /
            nrow(journeys_raw) * 100, 2)
  )
)
```

```{r validate-station-names}
journeys |>
  distinct(origin_id, origin_name) |>
  inner_join(
    stations |>
      select(station_id, station_name),
    by = c("origin_id" = "station_id")
  ) |>
  filter(
    tolower(trimws(origin_name)) !=
      tolower(trimws(station_name))
  )
```
